title: Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior - Dialogflow
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Python com foco em Dialogflow para integrar nosso time de tecnologia, atuando diretamente na construção e evolução de soluções de IA conversacional.


Buscamos alguém com experiência sólida em Python e vivência na criação de jornadas conversacionais no Dialogflow, integrando fluxos, APIs e serviços backend para entregar experiências conversacionais eficientes, escaláveis e bem estruturadas.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com bots, NLP, integrações e arquiteturas conversacionais, essa vaga é pra você.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Desenvolver e manter serviços backend em Python com foco em soluções conversacionais;
  • Criar, testar e evoluir jornadas conversacionais no Dialogflow;
  • Integrar fluxos do Dialogflow com APIs, serviços backend e modelos de linguagem, quando necessário;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros desenvolvedores e times de produto para transformar necessidades em soluções funcionais;
  • Participar da evolução da arquitetura das jornadas, garantindo escalabilidade, qualidade e performance.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em Python;
  • Vivência prática com Dialogflow na construção de bots e jornadas conversacionais;
  • Familiaridade com APIs REST e estruturas assíncronas (FastAPI, Flask, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);
  • Experiência com PostgreSQL, Redis ou bancos vetoriais como FAISS, Weaviate, pgvector.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Experiência prática com LangChain e/ou LangGraph.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About your team


Our Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.


What is the role?


We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.

This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.

While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.


In this role, you will:


  • Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
  • Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
  • Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
  • Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
  • Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
  • Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
  • Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
  • Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
  • Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
  • Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
  • Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflows


What you’ll bring:


  • Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
  • Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
  • Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.) , plus motion design
  • Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries; experience refining and scaling brand guidelines.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
  • Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working in SaaS, edtech, or within the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
  • Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.


While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps

  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience

  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)

title: Senior Splunk Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.


You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.


Responsibilities

1. Plan & Build

  • Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
  • Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
  • Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
  • Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
  • Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Build trend and capacity analyses.


2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)

  • Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
  • Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
  • Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.


3. Configuration & Release Management

  • Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
  • Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
  • Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
  • Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
  • Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.


4. Security, Hardening & Compliance

  • System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, SuSSHi, 2FA).
  • Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
  • Automate SOP-based operational workflows.


5. Transition

  • Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
  • Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
  • Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.


Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
  • Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
  • Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
  • Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.



Certifications (required)

Minimum two of:

  • Splunk Core Certified User
  • Splunk Core Certified Power User
  • Splunk Enterprise Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Architect
  • Optional: Splunk ES


Soft Skills

  • Strong communication in enterprise environments.
  • Clear documentation skills.
  • Proactive, quality-driven work style.
  • Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake & Observability Implementation)

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration: 6 Months

Need to work on PST hours


Mandatory Skills : Snowflake

DBT, Splunk, OpsGenie, Snowflake + Streamlit, Splunk Dashboards and Version Control & IaC


Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Senior Data Engineer to drive the execution phase of our migration from Amazon Redshift to Snowflake. The architectural design is complete; we need a builder who can code, implement, and operationalize the solution with a heavy focus on Good Governance, Data Quality, and Observability at scale.

You will pick up where a previous engagement left off, leveraging DBT for transformations and driving the roadmap for 2026. You will work alongside an existing Data Engineer but are expected to lead the implementation with high initiative.


Key Responsibilities

1. Migration & Transformation Execution

  • Lead the Implementation: Execute the transition from Redshift to Snowflake based on existing designs.
  • DBT Transformation: Utilize DBT to manage transformations for DMS (Database Migration Service) outputs and ensure seamless data integration.
  • Code & Drive: This is not a passive role. You will be responsible for writing the code, configuring the environment, and driving the project forward to meet 2026 roadmap goals.
  • Measure Output: Implement metrics to validate and measure the output of DMS processes to ensure accuracy.


2. Data Observability & Alerting at Scale

  • Enterprise Alerting Integration: Operationalize a Proof of Concept (POC) that connects Splunk to OpsGenie .
  • Scale Observability: Deploy observability checks (Freshness, Validity, Volume) across all tables in the ecosystem.
  • Incident Routing: Configure automated workflows to ensure alerts reach the correct contact immediately via OpsGenie.


3. Governance & Quality

  • Data Governance: Enforce \"Good Governance\" practices, including rigorous Data Quality (DQ) checks and comprehensive documentation.
  • Change Management: Manage the change process for data pipelines and schema evolution.
  • Advanced DQ Tooling: Operationalize a DQ POC using Atlan , specifically leveraging its natural language capabilities for data discovery and quality management.


Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Snowflake (Expert): Deep experience with Snowflake architecture and migration patterns (Redshift to Snowflake preferred).
  • DBT (Required): Strong proficiency in DBT for data modeling and transformation.
  • Observability Stack: Hands-on experience with Splunk and OpsGenie (specifically integrating the two for automated alerting).
  • Data Quality Tools: Familiarity with Atlan or similar modern data governance/catalog tools.
  • AWS DMS: Experience handling output from AWS Database Migration Service or similar migration tools.


Soft Skills & Attributes

  • High Initiative: You are a self-starter who identifies gaps and fixes them without needing constant direction.
  • Execution-Focused: You prefer building and coding over pure theory/design.
  • Communication: Ability to document technical processes clearly for future maintenance.

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.

  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows

  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Sul
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Sul



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Tech Lead Python
description:
Tech Lead - Python


A Shipay simplifica a forma de as empresas receberem e pagarem por meios digitais, como Pix, Bolepix e Carteiras Digitais. Com a regulamentação da Duplicata Escritural, vamos viabilizar o Pagamento em Duas Etapas, além de um hub de escrituração de duplicatas.

  • Qualidade de Software: Vivência no desenvolvimento e teste de aplicações distribuídas, assíncronas e aplicação de testes de software.
  • Visão de Engenharia: Experiência na aplicação de Design e Enterprise Patterns.
  • Habilidade Analítica: Capacidade de realizar estimativas precisas e gerir débitos técnicos de forma estratégica.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Delphi Especialista (IA)
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de

software, dados e integrações com IA, garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, apoiando decisões de design, arquitetura e implementação;
  • Atuar de forma hands on no desenvolvimento de soluções complexas, mantendo proximidade com o código e com os problemas reais do produto;
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções técnicas viáveis, avaliando alternativas e escolhendo as soluções tecnológicas mais adequadas, considerando trade-offs de qualidade, prazo, custo, escalabilidade, segurança e impacto operacional;
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura de aplicações, dados e integrações, garantindo consistência, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de software, como testes automatizados, versionamento, revisão de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de pipelines de dados, integrações assíncronas e soluções que se conectem a modelos de IA quando aplicável;
  • Atuar como ponto de referência técnica para o time, promovendo mentoria, troca de conhecimento e evolução da maturidade técnica;
  • Participar de discussões técnicas com produto, dados e áreas parceiras, apoiando decisões táticas e operacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria técnica e propor soluções que aumentem eficiência, confiabilidade e qualidade do produto;
  • Criar ou evoluir componentes reutilizáveis, padrões e frameworks/plataformas quando necessário para acelerar o desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a priorização técnica do backlog, sinalizando riscos, dependências e impactos arquiteturais;
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes, investigando causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais;
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de engenharia, alinhados aos objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado, arquitetura, dados e IA, disseminando conhecimento no time;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

● Sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Delphi;

● Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs (REST-HORSE) e API First;

● Fundamento em testes unitários – Conhecimento em Dunit;

● Unigui e Firemonkey – Nível avançado;

● Banco de Dados PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos;

● Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software;

● Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps;

● Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud);

● NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes;

● IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações;

● Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes.

description:

description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!

title: Senior Client Success Manager
description:
Senior Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Client Success Manager with 7+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 7+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Conhecimento avançado em Java e imprescindivel ter conhecimento em IA (o Copilot , CURSOR) \" para desenvolvimento\"; Se Tiver Ingles é um diferencial -------- Experiência em AWS, Banco de dados (Oracle, SQL Server), bons Conhecimento JBoss Message Queue Formação completa, preferencialmente em Engenharia, Informática ou áreas relacionadas; Capacidade de organização com múltiplas atividades e requisições simultâneas; Capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal para endereçar problemas e discutir soluções com as áreas envolvidas; Raciocínio lógico, capacidade analítica e de organização; Descrição da área: A área é responsável pela plataforma utilizada pelo time de BackOffice para batimento de boletas, custódia e caixa, além da alocação/execução/confirmação dos trades, valuation e settlement. Atuamos no desenvolvimento de melhorias operacionais e incorporação de novos produtos financeiros na plataforma, que é desenvolvida em Java e hospedada na cloud AWS.



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

Atuar com Application Packaging e Deployment em ambientes Windows, sendo responsável pela criação, atualização e implantação dos clientes AppGate, IBOSS e Infoblox via Microsoft Intune . O foco principal será garantir implantações estáveis, automatizadas e em conformidade. Quando não estiver envolvido em atividades de packaging, apoiará as rotinas do time EUC Shield .


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Criar e manter pacotes de aplicações para Windows.
  • Realizar deployment de aplicações e atualizações via Intune .
  • Desenvolver automações com PowerShell .
  • Garantir compliance e configuração adequada dos endpoints.
  • Documentar processos e apoiar a transição (KT/shadowing).
  • Colaborar com app owners e times de suporte.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência com Application Packaging (Windows) .
  • PowerShell avançado .
  • Microsoft Intune e SCCM .
  • Conhecimento em endpoint compliance e configuration management.
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente!!


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Boa comunicação e documentação.
  • Trabalho colaborativo.
  • Organização e foco em qualidade.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.

Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.

  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

description:
Estamos procurando um profissional com capacidade de realizar a análise de negócios, na área de Recursos Nauturais, orientando a equipe no desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.

  • Conhecimento em TI/infraestrutura;

  • Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto
  • Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes;
  • Conhecimento de DevOps;
  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Interpretar documentação e informações de negócio compreendendo processos de negócio mapeados e contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução e ao atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes.
  • Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas.
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery
  • Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes de alta complexidade.
  • Avaliar e selecionar as opções da plataforma ESRI que melhor atendam uma respectiva solução.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.

You’ll work on production SaaS systems built primarily on PHP 8 and CodeIgniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.


What You’ll Do

  • Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout
  • Deep-dive into existing PHP/CodeIgniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
  • Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
  • Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
  • Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
  • Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets


Core Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks)
  • Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, MySQL/MariaDB, PHP, Apache/Nginx)
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas


Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic DevOps workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
  • Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments


What We Care About Most

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes
  • Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it
  • Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early
  • Comfort working independently without constant oversight
  • Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness


Experience Level

  • 5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications
  • Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)


Working Environment

  • Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
  • Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
  • High trust, low micromanagement
  • Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction


Why This Role

  • Real systems, real users, real problems
  • Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
  • Opportunity to be a true owner, not a ticket-taker
  • Competitive compensation with room for growth

title: AI Solutions Engineer (Support & Implementation)
description:
The Role


We are Appointwise. We build high-end AI infrastructure that replaces manual sales teams with autonomous digital workforces. We recently launched Appointwise 2.0 , a visual, node-based platform that allows businesses to architect complex behavior, not just simple chatbots.


We are looking for a Solutions Engineer . This is not a standard customer support role where you read from a script. You are the technical architect for our clients. You will be debugging complex logic flows, building agents live on Zoom to demonstrate capabilities, and solving implementation blockers instantly.


What You Will Do


  • Enterprise & Standard Support: You will manage support across all client tiers. This includes handling complex custom implementations for Enterprise clients while providing efficient, day-to-day troubleshooting for standard users.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: You will diagnose and resolve logic errors, infinite loops, and variable configuration issues within our node-based builder by using back-end logs/systems.
  • Live Implementation: You will join calls with enterprise clients to build and configure custom workflows in real-time, ensuring their agents are set up correctly for deployment.
  • Video-First Resolution: You will manage support tickets with a focus on clarity. Instead of long text replies, you will frequently record Loom videos to visually explain fixes and guide users through the solution.
  • Product Improvement: You will identify recurring bugs and user friction points, reporting them to the engineering team to help prioritize platform updates.


Who We Are Looking For


  • You are an Automation Native: You have deep experience with visual logic builders (Make, n8n, Voiceflow, or GoHighLevel Workflows). You understand JSON, Webhooks, and API payloads.
  • You Explain Complexity Simply: You can explain technical concepts (like how a variable passes data between nodes) to a non-technical business owner without jargon.
  • You are Presentable & Sharp: You are comfortable on camera. You have a professional setup, clear audio, and the ability to think on your feet during live demos.
  • You are \"Inbox Zero\" Obsessed: You hate leaving problems unsolved. You are proactive, fast, and thorough.


Requirements


  • Proven experience building complex automations (Portfolio or examples required).
  • Deep understanding of LLMs (Prompt engineering, Context windows, System prompts).
  • Excellent written and verbal English (Native or C2 level).
  • Been in a previous customer facing technical support roles
  • Ability to work US/EST hours.


How to Apply


We do not just want a cover letter.


  • Record a short Loom video (max 3 minutes).
  • Tell us about the most complex automation you have ever built and your previous support roles.
  • Explain how it worked and why you built it.
  • Send the link along with your CV/Resume.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.
